error: Harness stdin write EPIPE while sending stop to load worker; unhandled stream error masked the child's exit diagnostic
action: Preserved every completed pair. Added stdin error handling and explicit child-exit failure propagation, then resumed the unfinished pair with --resume.
limitation: No valid complete timing pair was recorded for the interrupted attempt; its underlying child exit reason was not captured. This is not counted as a successful measurement.

secondInterruption.error: Unexpected end of JSON input in developmentBusy while reading the newly created lease file
secondInterruption.resolution: Publish the fully written lease by atomic rename; added concurrent polling regression. Start a separate stream-atomic variant; incomplete stream-check pairs are preserved and not used as passing evidence.

thirdInterruption.error: Concurrent polling regression detected Windows EPERM while the lease file was being deleted
thirdInterruption.resolution: Stopped the task-owned measurement processes. Treat transient EPERM/EBUSY conservatively as busy and recheck on the next poll. All 17 recall regressions passed before starting the separate stream-atomic-v2 campaign.
